title: Coordinate expectation is preserved by polarization
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$. The coordinate expectation of the real-valued polarization of $f$ in coordinate $i$ equals the coordinate expectation of $f$ after interpreting its signs as real numbers.
